entrypoints: 单账号与结构化批量导入；纯邮箱复用仍不写入

review_records.subfeature: Typed account receipt evidence and precise selection consumption
review_records.inputs_outputs: Dynamic JSON becomes a closed submission outcome plus confirmed IDs. Invalid, contradictory, foreign or incomplete evidence produces ACCOUNT_RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED with unknown outcome.
review_records.preconditions: Requested ID set, types, aliases, counts and ok/outcome/uncertain agree. Single response job identity matches the submitted account.
review_records.transitions: HTTP response -> receipt validation -> confirmed admission or unconfirmed result. Queued means accepted, never completed authorization/security workflow.
dependencies: Backend batch_outcome.go, cpa_upload.go and Sub2 upsert contracts
review_records.persistence: No raw token/password/credential receipt added to ordinary logs. Existing batch TOTP intent is acknowledged only with reliable full-batch admission.
review_records.concurrency: Receipt consumed only by its current command generation. Confirmed IDs can clear only the unchanged original selection.
review_records.recovery: Invalid evidence retains selection and draft. Aggregate Sub2 partial success cannot invent local IDs. Older aggregate-only CPA responses remain displayable but remove no IDs. Legacy started alias retained.
review_records.evidence: Old batch handler checked only jobs array and two numeric fields; Sub2 HTTP200 cleared all selected IDs. New decoder validates identity/count/outcome agreement, including CPA skipped counts containing failures before dispatch. Follow-up: single receipt already had an explicit positive-outcome whitelist; cancellation now requires an explicit completed/succeeded outcome if present. End-to-end tests preserve TOTP intent and selection for explicit unknown, failed, partial or unrecognized outcomes without flags or with contradictory positive flags.
review_records.decision: Integrated strict receipt boundary; removed unused loose confirmedCPAUploadIds helper and migrated all prior invalid/partial result assertions to the new decoder.
review_records.compatibility: Unknown fields and existing started/aggregate display compatibility retained; contradictory success becomes visible unknown. No backend validation relaxed.
